description: As a flight ops manager I want to be warned when I select a grounded aircraft so that I avoid scheduling errors.

acs.text: If the selected aircraft has status Grounded, a warning modal is displayed before submission is allowed.
branches: aircraft status = Grounded → warning modal shown
aircraft status != Grounded → no modal shown

acs.text: The warning modal contains 'Proceed anyway' and 'Choose different aircraft' action buttons.
If the user clicks 'Proceed anyway', the form submits normally.
branches: user clicks Proceed anyway → form submits
user clicks Choose different aircraft → modal closes, aircraft field re-enabled

acs.text: The page load time for the flight creation form must be under 2 seconds.

sections.content: The form is accessible from the weekly schedule view via the '+ New Flight' button.
